name: Krenko, Mob Boss (mono-red goblins, Bracket 3)
notes:
DeckCheck scan of https://deckcheck.co/app/decklist/yWNbdOkbDhOl (creator Cronknight), CRISPI 6.00, Bracket 3. Numbers copied from the CRISPI panel, not inferred. The corpus's first mono-red deck and first mid-power deck with a real scan behind it.

CONSISTENCY 6 - "reliable game plans with 32 lands, low average mana value, and dedicated Goblin tutors like Goblin Recruiter and Goblin Matron. Red rummaging spells and Skullclamp supplement card velocity."

RESILIENCE 7 - "a deep suite of recursive threats, multiple independent combo packages, and sacrifice outlets like Goblin Chirurgeon and Pashalik Mons allow the deck to pivot if Krenko is removed. However, low mass protection leaves token boards vulnerable to repeated board wipes."

INTERACTION 4 - "focused heavily on creature removal via direct damage outlets like Massive Raid, Pashalik Mons, and Goblin Bombardment. Virtually no counterspells and limited non-creature answers, relying almost entirely on Chaos Warp and Goblin Trashmaster."

SPEED 7 - band table maps Speed 7 to win turn 5. "Fast aggro-combo pace, reliably threatening lethal damage on turn 5. Turn 1 Mountain and Skirk Prospector." Judged by the AI, not by formula - see the Speed RULE APPLIED text recorded in braids-conjurer-adept.json.
